r2_tc-open_basic.label: terrain-controls default
r2_tc-open_basic.verdict:
**Not CLEAN** — a few issues found:

**Overlapping / clipped (Q1)**
1. **High** — The dark onboarding tooltip "Click any item to add it to your yard" sits on top of the "Getting Started" card and clips/hides its body text (only fragments like "Cho… d…" are visible on the left edge). The tooltip also has no arrow/anchor, so it reads as a misplaced popup rather than a coach mark.
2. **Medium** — A stray dark pill labeled **"Daytime"** floats at the top-center of the 3D canvas, unanchored to anything. The Sun control it presumably describes is in the bottom toolbar — this looks like a tooltip rendering at the wrong position.
3. **Low** — The "Patio" row at the bottom of the sidebar is clipped mid-icon. Probably just scroll cutoff, but worth verifying the list container isn't overflowing.

**Confusing / questionable (Q2 & Q3)**
4. **Medium** — **Duplicate Terrain controls**: "Terrain" appears in the bottom-left mode panel, again in the bottom-center toolbar, and terrain state in the status bar. A new user can't tell which is which or what each does.
5. **Medium** — Toolbar button **"Innovate"** looks like a typo (presumably "Irrigate"?) — as written it's meaningless as a yard-design tool.
6. **Low** — Status bar shows "Brush: 8 ft" while Tool is "Select"; brush size is irrelevant for the select tool and may confuse.
7. Cosmetic — compass needle slightly overlaps the "S" label.

**5-second comprehension:** The core concept (pick items on the left, build in the 3D yard) comes through, but the clipped tooltip, orphaned "Daytime" pill, and duplicated Terrain buttons make the UI feel buggy on first glance. Fix #1 and #2 before ship.

r2_tc-open_adv.label: terrain-controls default (Advanced)
r2_tc-open_adv.verdict:
**Not CLEAN — a few minor issues, no blockers.**

**Summary:** A clear, well-organized 3D backyard design UI with a solid top bar, catalog sidebar, and viewport, but it has redundant onboarding messaging, a duplicated "Terrain" control, and several small polish issues.

**Findings:**

1. **Duplicated "Terrain" control (confusing/ambiguous).** The floating card at bottom-left already contains a "Terrain" item, and a separate pill button labeled "Terrain" sits ~2 inches to its right in the tool row. Two adjacent controls with the same name and near-identical mountain icons will confuse users about which does what. Rename or merge one.

2. **Triple-redundant onboarding copy.** The same instruction appears three times simultaneously: the dark welcome tooltip at top ("Click items on the left to build your yard"), the center toast ("👋 Click an item from the left panel…"), and the sidebar's Getting Started note. Pick one (the top tooltip is the best placed) and suppress the others.

3. **Clipped sidebar item.** "Patio" under Patios & Paths is cut off mid-row at the bottom of the panel — its subtitle (which every other item has) is not visible. It reads as a scroll affordance, but the truncated row looks slightly broken; add bottom padding or a fade.

4. **Compass "S" label hidden.** The compass rose shows N, W, and E, but the "S" label is obscured by the red needle arrow. Rotate the needle or offset the label.

5. **Scale bar touches the Sun button.** The "10 ft" scale bar's right edge sits ~1px from the Sun pill's left edge — their borders nearly merge into one control. Add ~8–12px spacing (they're also on slightly different baselines).

6. **"FPS: —" in the status bar.** The em dash reads as uninitialized/broken. Show a measured value or hide the FPS readout until available.

Nothing overlaps in a way that hides content, no broken images or layout shifts, and a new user would grasp the screen within a few seconds — the issues above are polish-level.
